description: Na₇Au₅S₆ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbcn space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four equivalent Au and four S atoms to form distorted corner-sharing NaAu₄S₄ hexagonal bipyramids. There are two shorter (3.18 Å) and two longer (3.23 Å) Na-Au bond lengths. There are two shorter (2.87 Å) and two longer (2.95 Å) Na-S bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two Au and four S atoms. There is one shorter (3.27 Å) and one longer (3.32 Å) Na-Au bond length. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.80-2.97 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to three Au and four S atoms. There is one shorter (3.13 Å) and two longer (3.25 Å) Na-Au bond lengths. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.84-2.90 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two Au and four S atoms. There is one shorter (3.08 Å) and one longer (3.16 Å) Na-Au bond length. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.89-2.98 Å. There are three inequivalent Au sites. In the first Au site, Au is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two S atoms. Both Au-S bond lengths are 2.33 Å. In the second Au site, Au is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two S atoms. There is one shorter (2.33 Å) and one longer (2.34 Å) Au-S bond length. In the third Au site, Au is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to six Na and two equivalent S atoms. Both Au-S bond lengths are 2.34 Å. There are three inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to six Na and one Au atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing SNa₆Au pentagonal bipyramids. In the second S site, S is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two Au atoms. In the third S site, S is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two Au atoms.
